Beef Curry Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 11:11pm

Ingredients




1 pound ground beef, browned
1 1/2 cups raw rice
3 cups water (may need more water, can use 1 (10 oz.) can tomato soup
1 lg. onion, sliced
1 1/4 teaspoons curry powder
3 tablespoons bovril
1 can sliced mushrooms or brown ½ lb. fresh 
Preparation

1 Put all ingredients together in a large serving casserole. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1/4 hours. Stir several times while cooking. Check for moisture. Serve with sour cream. 2 Serves 6-8.
